# Visual Schedule (Visual Schedule Daily Routine)

> Visual Schedule is an iOS app that shows a child's day as pictures, icons and
> timers, so kids can follow their routine on their own. Made for children with
> autism, ADHD and focus challenges — and any kid who does better when the day
> is visible. Free to download on the App Store; optional premium features via
> in-app purchase.

Developer: Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska (Apps for Parents).
Website: https://visual-schedule.app/

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone, iPad & Mac (Apple only — there is no Android version)
- Price: free to download; optional premium features via in-app purchase
- App Store rating: 4.4 stars (769 ratings)
- Used by 10,000+ families
- Age rating: 4+; available in 21 languages
- 130+ built-in task icons; also supports your own photos, Pixabay images, and
  AI-generated icons via Apple Intelligence (Image Playground)
- Full-screen visual timer with final countdown, visual and sound alerts
- Start times and reminders per activity
- Kid Profiles: separate profile per child (schedules, tasks, progress)
- Ready-made routine templates; color-coded week view; confetti celebration
- Can be used as a first-then board (two-task schedule)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1508150689?pt=118868513&ct=webnew&mt=8
